name: print-social-grid-poster-with-red-and-white-lines-on-black
title: Rotated 'GRID' word beside a lattice of white and red lines on black with orange border
whatItIs: A poster with an orange frame, a black field with a huge grey rotated 'GRID' at the top left with small paragraphs beside it, and below and to the right thick white and red horizontal and vertical lines forming a woven lattice.
whatItMeans: Structured and lively; the lines show the idea of a grid literally.
techniques: Illustrate the word with a lattice.

vocabulary.definition: A single red line among white ones.
A coloured border around a poster.
